notes: v2.80 (2026-11-07, afternoon run): 79th tower 'Scarf' (rounded top over wide bands on two fringed ends, 22 blocks, 5 clusters sizes 6/6/6/2/2, all 4 colours, no singletons) + 76th co-play prompt (drape a scarf like a cape, wrap a teddy snug, hide-and-find peek-a-boo; never tight around a little neck). Scarf-play research: cover/uncover builds object permanence, pulling off builds fine-motor grip, and a scarf is an open-ended prop (cape, doll blanket, den roof). Block Pop replaced the 9-activity menu game on 2026-10-13 (kept as classic.html). One deep mechanic: tap a color cannon, blast matching block clusters, clear the tower. v2.79 (2026-11-07, parent report + browser test): fixed the leftover colored dot after a pop. The block and its white glyph were being removed correctly — the dot was a stuck pop particle. burst() used `var p` in a loop, so all six onfinish handlers closed over the same variable and only the last particle was ever removed; the other five sat at full opacity in the middle of the popped block (browser test: 4 blue dots, one per popped block, still there at 6s). Fixed with the same per-particle IIFE capture the ball code already uses, plus fill:'forwards' and a 900ms sweep so no particle can outlive the pop. Verified with a node closure test (old code removes 1 of 6, new code removes 6 of 6). v2.78 grew the cutscene rotation to 3 movies and retired frog-garden. Content-only repo: no personal data beyond the first name.
